# Sprunkin

> > Sprunkin is a comprehensive hub for playing Sprunki mods and Incredibox games, featuring a curated collection of fan-made and original music-creation games with horror, creative, and themed variations.

Sprunkin serves as the primary platform for discovering and playing Sprunki mods, which are creative variations of the Incredibox music game. The site aggregates both official releases and community-submitted fan mods, organized by popularity, recency, theme, and gameplay style.
